subject: Pilot setup: quick recap and priority check
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@acrahealth.com>
Cc: Samir Shah <samir.shah@acrahealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot setup: quick recap & initial asks

Hi Priya (and Samir),

Thanks for taking time today — appreciated the candid discussion about the use case and success metrics. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Goal: Validate 2 core flows (document ingestion + contextual search) with latency under 250ms for 95th pct.
- Success criteria: 50k tokens/day of mixed traffic during the 2-week pilot; basic accuracy checks against your internal set.
- Action items:
  1) Acra to share network whitelist + sandbox VPC details (blocked right now) — Samir to own.
  2) Jasmine to share POC kickoff checklist and test dataset template. (attached)
  3) Schedule 30-min enablement with engineering once sandbox is open.

I attached a short POC-kickoff-checklist.pdf to this thread and a template we can drop the first dataset into. If priority has shifted on your side, please let me know and we can pause/adjust — otherwise, can Samir share the network details this week?

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachment: POC-kickoff-checklist.pdf (pdf)

Hi Priya —

Quick bump on the network/VPC details and whether the checklist landed in the right inbox. We haven't seen traffic from your side. If you need a different format for network info (or a call to go through it), happy to set that up.

If timeline has moved, totally fine — tell me what date works and I'll update our plan.

Cheers,
Jasmine

Date: 2026-10-27T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Checking priority — pilot timing for AcraHealth

Hi Priya — looping in Vivek from our team in case there are procurement/security questions we can help unblock.

Short note: we haven't received the whitelist or the sandbox details, and the POC is scheduled for later this month on our side. Two quick questions:

1) Has the pilot been deprioritized internally? If so, what would be a better window to restart?
2) If it's still a go, can we get an estimated date when Samir can send the VPC + firewall rules so we can provision a sandbox?

We can also offer a short workshop for your infra/security team to walk through the minimal requirements if that helps accelerate things. Vivek — any suggestions on collateral that typically helps with security teams?

Thanks,
Jasmine

--
Jasmine Liu | Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T08:16:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: AcraHealth pilot stalled — proposed next steps

Vivek / Neha,

Status: After three nudges, no network details from Acra; Samir has not replied. Priya exchanged one quick ping but said they'd be back to us.

Options I'm considering:
- Option A (light): Pause active provisioning, move pilot start to mid-November. Keep them on a single weekly check-in.
- Option B (assist): Offer a 45-min infra workshop + provide templated firewall playbook and our network inventory spreadsheet. Attach the inventory to send — reduces back-and-forth.
- Option C (escalate): Ask for an executive intro to procurement/security if Acra wants to preserve the original timeline.

I attached our network-inventory.xlsx to the thread for Option B. My preference is Option B this week to nudge progress without scaring them off. Thoughts?

Thanks,
Jasmine

Attachment: network-inventory.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@acrahealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Shah <samir.shah@acrahealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T15:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot setup: quick recap & priority check

Hi Jasmine — sorry for the radio silence. Short update: procurement/security have paused external sandbox work while we complete an internal vendor assessment (timeline slipped due to an audit). Samir is tied up with the audit response this week so he couldn't share the whitelist yet.

We still want to run the pilot — just pushed by about 3 weeks. Can we tentatively target the week of Nov 23 for the sandbox go-live? In the meantime, the Option B collateral sounds useful — please send the inventory and a 30–45 min walkthrough we can invite our security engineer to.

Thanks for the patience — Priya
